description: The InboundMappingProcessor.java is a Java class responsible for processing incoming ExternalMessages into Signals, applying message mappings, handling errors, and managing headers within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging component. It encapsulates the logic for message transformation and mapping execution within the inbound message processing pipeline.

classes.name: InboundMappingProcessor
